title: A2-18 · Forms IV, V, VI, VII, VIII and X

blocks.text: A2-18 · Forms IV, V, VI, VII, VIII and X
Lesson overview

In A2-17 you have studied forms II and III. Other derived forms are recognized by prefixes and schemes: ⁧أَرْسَلَ⁩ (IV), ⁧تَكَلَّمَ⁩ ( V), ⁧تَعَاوَنَ⁩ (VI) ⁧اِنْقَطَعَ⁩ (VII), ⁧اِجْتَمَعَ⁩ (III), ⁧اِسْتَقْبَلَ⁩ ( X). Many of these verbs have been using them for months ( ⁧أَعْطَى⁩ , ⁧تَعَلَّمَ⁩ , ⁧اِنْتَظَرَ⁩ , ⁧اِتَّصَلَ⁩ , ⁧اِسْتَطَاعَ⁩ ); Here you put them in a unique system. The objective of A2 is to recognize: given a word in a title without vowels, find the root, form and sense, and know how to read the maṣdar and the participle. News is the ideal ground: it's full of derived forms. A week.

2. know the most frequent value of any form (causeative, reflective, reciprocal, passive-medium,
consider (s) to be (s) of the following categories:
3. recognize the assimilations of form VIII ( ⁧اِتَّصَلَ⁩ , ⁧اِزْدَحَمَ⁩ , ⁧اِضْطَرَّ⁩ ) and the difference between VII and VIII with roots in
4. recognizing verbs of four letters ( ⁧تَرْجَمَ⁩ );
5. reading and understanding news titles without vowels.

4. Forms V and VI:

V · ⁧تَفَعَّلَ⁩ is the reflexive or passive of II: ⁧عَلَّمَ⁩ • Teach → ⁧تَعَلَّمَ⁩ • learning (teaching), ⁧غَيَّرَ⁩ Change (something) → ⁧تَغَيَّرَ⁩ Change (become different) It is recognized by the ta- and the double.
VI · ⁧تَفَاعَلَ⁩ It is often mutual: "doing together, one with the other." It is recognized by the ā after the first radical.
The V and VI forms have the a also in the penultimate syllable of the imperfect: ⁧يَتَكَلَّمُ⁩ , ⁧يَتَعَاوَنُ⁩ (do not "yatakallimu").

7. How one recognizes a form: the method
1. Remove the imperfect person prefix ( ⁧يَـ⁩ , ⁧تَـ⁩ , ⁧أَ⁩ , ⁧نَـ⁩ / ⁧يُـ⁩ ...) and terminations ( ⁧ـونَ⁩ , ⁧ـتُ⁩ , ⁧ـوا⁩ …).
2. Look at the beginning: ⁧أَ⁩ to the perfect → IV; ⁧تَـ⁩ + double → V; ⁧تَـ⁩ + ⁧ا⁩ → VI; ⁧اِنْـ⁩ → VII (or VIII with root in ⁧ن⁩ ); ⁧اِ⁩ _ ⁧تَ⁩ → VIII;
⁧اِسْتَـ⁩ → X; ⁧مُ⁩ ... → participle; ⁧تَفْعِيل⁩ , ⁧إِفْعَال⁩ , ⁧اِفْتِعَال⁩ , ⁧اِسْتِفْعَال⁩ → maṣdar.
3. Look at the center: double → II or V; ā after the first radical → III or VI.
4. There are three letters left: it is the root. Search in the dictionary and choose the right way to form.

Without vowels, forms II and I are confused ( ⁧درس⁩ , ⁧علم⁩ ), as well as IV and I in some people ( ⁧أرسل⁩ is IV, but ⁧أكتب⁩ "Write is I": use context and, to the imperfect, difference ⁧يُرْسِلُ⁩ / ⁧يَكْتُبُ⁩ , but you can't see without vowels. The forms III, V, VI, VII, VIII, X instead are almost always recognized even without vowels.
8. Pronunciation

The union wing. wa-nqaṭaʿat, fa-stamaʿa, al-mudīru staqbala: the forms VII, VIII and X The doubles of assimilation. ittaṣala, ittfaqa: the t is double. izdaḥama: z e d neighbors, no vowel in between. yuʿlinu / yaʿlamu. The yu-prefix of IV and the ya-prefix of I distinguish words as ⁧يُعْلِمُ⁩ • information (IV) and ⁧يَعْلَمُ⁩ Saithe (I).
9. New lexicon

Notes of use. ⁧يَعْتَقِلُ⁩ and ⁧اِعْتِقَال⁩ are the words of the news to stop, stop, together with ⁧أَلْقَى القَبْضَ عَلَى⁩ and ⁧تَمَّ القَبْضُ عَلَى⁩ ( A2-16). ⁧يَتَنَاوَلُ⁩ has two uses: formal for eating, taking ( ⁧تَنَاوَلْنَا الغَدَاءَ⁩ We've had lunch. ⁧تَنَاوُلُ الدَّوَاءِ⁩ • taking the medicine and treating a theme ( ⁧يَتَنَاوَلُ الكِتَابُ تَارِيخَ مِصْرَ⁩ ). ⁧مُجْتَمَع⁩ is a passive participle of VIII used as the name: ⁧المُجْتَمَعُ الإِيطَالِيُّ⁩ The Italian company is the company. ⁧يَتَقَدَّمُ بِطَلَبٍ⁩ The administrative formula is to submit an application (A2-22). ⁧يَسْتَخْدِمُ⁩ and ⁧يَسْتَعْمِلُ⁩ ( A2-04) are almost synonymous; the former is more frequent in technical texts.
